status: native component and source adapter implementation only
premise: The completed integer reference supplies synthetic causality and inverse evidence only. Implement the distinct native probability boundary before freezing an FX2 scientific gate.

configuration.alphabet: 2..256 ordered symbols; native FX2 uses its authenticated 205-symbol vocabulary
configuration.base: Original float32 row after existing half conversion and >=1e-6 guard. Preserve the upstream scalar subnormal quirk. Reject values outside [float32(1e-6),1].
configuration.expected: Decode each positive IEEE float32 exactly into integer units of 2^-43. Normalize to total Q16 mass with largest remainders and ascending-id ties.
configuration.history: Prior 32*65536, one Q16 observed count after truth, expected base counts after truth, floor-halving both histories after every 256 observed symbols.
configuration.correction: Floor(65536*(prior+observed)/(prior+expected)), clipped to [16384,262144]. D/S replace each float32 p by float32(float64(p)*multiplier/65536), with nearest-even rounding. This is a new explicit native boundary, not bit-identical to the earlier integer-output reference.

controls.P: Original output bits, no learned history
controls.K: Learn histories but preserve original output bits
controls.S: Learn from successor vocabulary index modulo alphabet size

configuration.integration: Inside Predictor::TransformerByteUpdate observe the completed token against the preceding pending row, then predict on the next clamped native row immediately before ByteMixer::SetProbs. Skip the first unpredicted token. Do not reset this calibration at article boundaries. Preserve all original transformer, PPM and final-mixer updates.
configuration.unsupported_modes: Reject explicit non-P calibration when native transformer is absent, transformer-only, PPM-only, loaded probability mode, or probability dumping is selected; do not silently report another boundary.
